A transient bit flip or forced value on `openMSP430.execution_unit_0.reg_pc_call` before the next `mclk` edge can substitute a false target or assert the software-write selection on the wrong instruction. The corrupted target is captured in `pc`, redirecting control flow, skipping intended instructions, or executing an unintended basic block.
